scenes.dialogue: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. In a disproportionate assets case, who must explain the excess: the prosecution, or the public servant?
On twenty eighth October, a two-judge Supreme Court bench of Honourable Justice Sanjay Kumar and Honourable Justice Sanjeev Sachdeva ruled.
scenes.shown: On 28 October, a two-judge Supreme Court bench of Honourable Justice Sanjay Kumar and Honourable Justice Sanjeev Sachdeva ruled.

scenes.dialogue: The appellant became a Sub Registrar in nineteen ninety three. The check period ran from January that year to January two thousand one.
scenes.shown: The appellant became a Sub Registrar in 1993. The check period ran from January that year to January 2001.

scenes.dialogue: The prosecution proved assets beyond likely savings of over five lakh twenty five thousand rupees: over fifty one percent of the family's income.
scenes.shown: The prosecution proved assets beyond likely savings of over ₹5.25 lakh: over 51% of the family's income.

scenes.dialogue: The trial court convicted the appellant in two thousand nine. In twenty twenty five, the High Court upheld the conviction, but cut the sentence to one year.
scenes.shown: The trial court convicted the appellant in 2009. In 2025, the High Court upheld the conviction, but cut the sentence to one year.

scenes.dialogue: The appellant argued the case rested on estimates: household costs taken for an agricultural family, and his building valued too high.
His cost notebook was no account kept in the ordinary course of business. And even on his own figures, the excess stays above twenty six percent.
scenes.shown: His cost notebook was no account kept in the ordinary course of business. And even on his own figures, the excess stays above 26%.

scenes.dialogue: The Court held: once the prosecution proves known income and the disproportion, the burden shifts to the accused. Undisclosed sources lie in his special knowledge.
Investigators need not chase every source an accused may claim later. The appeal was dismissed, and the appellant must surrender within two weeks.
